description:
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Exhaust Pipe Installation Kit
Gives you everything you need to Attach the Exhaust Pipe to the Exhaust Manifold.
You get BOTH Bolts & Springs
Bolts are Electroplated with Black Zinc for High Corrosion Resistance
Genuine Suzuki OEM
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – Exhaust Pipe Bolts (Black Zinc)
Qty 2 – Exhaust Pipe Springs
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
